fatal_finding: At line 52 of the affected candidate, pairwise coprimality of cofactor integers a_i does NOT imply that at most one a_i equals 1. Arbitrarily many 1s are pairwise coprime. For the actual simple group A7, its proper point stabilizer A6 has index 7. Choosing it seven times gives seven proper-subgroup indices all 7, all pairwise gcd 7; its seven distinct cosets are even pairwise disjoint and partition A7. Therefore the candidate's first-paragraph assertion that every A_n excludes seven proper-subgroup indices with pairwise gcd 7 is explicitly FALSE.
